summary: Regression + new-feature verification for TraceTax AI trust/explainability enhancements. 19/19 Playwright checks pass. Regression: queue with 12 returns, search + empty state + clear, opening Jordan Lee return, section nav (wages/interest/deductions), Accept AI flow with dialog + confirm + toast, Source tab, aggregation, missing-source request-document-btn, locked-jump links, resolve-conflict buttons all still work. New features verified: assistant-note, why-flagged, confidence-factors (4 items with +/-/neutral chips), uncertainty-card, and recommendation-provenance render on the Wages needs-review field Summary tab; provenance shows Source document / Page 1 / Field-Box / Direct mapping / Extracted value rows. Interest field renders provenance in aggregation mode with 2 provenance-component rows (First Bank $740 + Community CU $520 = $1,260). Charitable (missing-source) renders request-document-btn plus all four new trust cards. Employer name (conflicting-evidence) renders provenance in conflict mode with 2 provenance-conflict-source rows plus resolve-conflict buttons. Mortgage interest (verified) shows green Verified callout AND recommendation-provenance. Total itemized deductions (locked) shows locked-explanation AND recommendation-provenance titled 'How this value is calculated' with 'Calculated field' type. Reasoning tab uses 'What I checked' wording (old 'What the AI did' string not present anywhere) and includes why-flagged, confidence-factors, recommendation-provenance, uncertainty-card. 'What I'd suggest' label present. Zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: All new trust cards use consistent, stable data-testid attributes — good testability.

RecommendationProvenance renders 'Page 1' by using formatted string 'Page {evidence.page}'; if evidence.page is ever null (e.g., aggregation/conflict paths), that row is skipped correctly. No regression observed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 16 acceptance items from the review request verified via Playwright with data-testid selectors. Prototype is frontend-only (no backend). State resets on refresh (expected). Conditional testids like request-document-btn / locked-jump-* / resolve-conflict-* / provenance-component / provenance-conflict-source require selecting the specific field row first.
